Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time to speak last week. Quick note to confirm our demo: we have you tentatively scheduled for Tuesday, May 12 at 10:00 AM PT. The session will cover a 25-minute product walkthrough focused on low-latency serving, a short Q&A, and a 10-minute discussion on pricing and deployment options.

Proposed agenda:
- 0–5 min: Intros and goals
- 5–30 min: Demo (throughput/latency, routing, cost controls)
- 30–40 min: Q&A and next steps

If that slot works, I’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in. I’m copying Camila (solutions) who will join to cover technical fit. I’ve attached the requirements doc you shared so we can align the demo.

Thanks — look forward to it.

Ben / Camila —

Unfortunately I need to ask that we pause the demo for now. We had a leadership shift on the product roadmap this week and our investment in an inference initiative is being deprioritized for Q2. Additionally, a couple of the key stakeholders (including our Director of Platform) will be traveling the week of the demo and won’t be able to join.

Could we put the demo on hold and circle back in ~8–12 weeks? I’ll reach out when we have clearer priorities.

Appreciate your flexibility, and apologies for the short notice.

Best,
Samir
